cues: Silver oxide dissolves in excess ammonia to give Tollens' reagent, used in the silver mirror test for aldehydes.
Heated strongly, silver nitrate decomposes to silver, nitrogen dioxide and oxygen.
It is used for photographic film, indelible ink, Tollens' reagent, testing for halides, and argentometric titrations.
